review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. The PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision; OPT-2 is background, not a simultaneous delivery obligation. This supports ready with no blocking reasons for C, while a material unresolved DEC-001 in B must still block at decisions before Scenario Coverage. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, TASK-IMPLEMENT and TASK-VERIFY are consistent across the specification and Gold, including independent verification dependent on implementation and coverage of every required AC. The source establishes core/api.ts as the shared construction-time implementation owner for classic and mini, with the two exact regression-test paths completing the writable scope. Forwarding and declaration consumers are appropriately inspection-only; the package build configuration supports generated declarations rather than separately maintained declaration owners. The selected agents have the relevant supplied active trusted capability claims, matching delivery roles and availability; eligibility does not depend on Persona or pending legacy claims. A separate configured project Reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. Repository, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, policy and budget fingerprints are explicitly frozen. Original-specification preparation flags are not evidence of candidate execution or a contradiction of expected planning readiness. No candidate outputs informed this review. Approval concerns the independent expectation, not execution readiness, task dispatch, implementation correctness or a human attestation. I used only the supplied evidence and neither executed code nor independently recomputed digests.
